title: OneDrive: uninstall the Photos experience without affecting file sync
summary: Hold: the briefing turns the absence of a documented uninstall policy into an unsupported assertion that administrators cannot prevent removal. Its broader assurance that nothing changes about stored or synced data also exceeds the roadmap's narrower promises. The roadmap details and quoted release notes and licensing text are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this independent-uninstall feature.
claims.quote: Searched: "OneDrive Photos" "uninstall"; opened sync-release-notes, use-group-policy and support.microsoft.com/onedrive/windows/browse-your-photos-on-windows. They describe browsing and app governance, not this independent-removal option.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document what independent removal does to cached or indexed photo data.
claims.quote: Searched: OneDrive Photos removal cached indexed data minimum version personal work school accounts; opened sync-release-notes and Browse and manage your photos on Windows. Neither documents removal of cached or indexed data for this option.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and .api; summary; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: No administrator UI setting or automation controlling permission to independently uninstall OneDrive Photos is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "OneDrive Photos" policy PowerShell registry disable uninstall; OneDrive Photos uninstall administrator switch default enabled Microsoft Graph SharePoint PowerShell. Read use-group-policy and Browse and manage your photos on Windows; neither documents permission to uninstall.

claims.claim: The cited OneDrive Group Policy and Intune settings page lists no setting mentioning the Photos uninstall option.
claims.quote: Searched: photos|uninstall across the fetched use-group-policy page; no matches. Read its introduction and List of policies by string ID.

claims.claim: Administrators cannot stop individual users from choosing to uninstall the Photos experience.
claims.quote: Searched: "OneDrive Photos" "prevent" "uninstall"; OneDrive Photos policy PowerShell registry disable uninstall. Read use-group-policy and Browse and manage your photos on Windows. Neither states that administrators cannot prevent removal.
claims.fix: Delete ', so you cannot stop individual users from choosing it'. Keep only 'Microsoft Learn documents no administrator setting to allow or prevent the removal (see the controls table).'
